name: La Jetée
source:
La Jetée is a Visual Novel about ‘a man marked by an image from his childhood‘.

"A memory has haunted the hero of the tale since his childhood — the image of a woman and that of the killing of a man, at the jetty of the airport Orly in Paris. There is the timeless theme of star-crossed lovers, against the backdrop of an underground camp in a world completely devastated by a nuclear war. There are the rulers of the camps, who ruthlessly apply their scientific methods, supposedly to perpetuate life on the planet, while forcing humankind to give up on all that is beautiful. They use the memory of the hero of the story to catapult him back and forth in time, to find a source of energy, to save the human species. In his journey into the past, he meets a woman and a tragic love grows between them. After a series of events, the man eventually finds himself in the time and the place of the image that has always haunted him; he sees the face of a woman that represents to him love and life in a world without wars. Before meeting with her, he is killed by a camp guard who has followed him from the underground camp, from which he escaped."

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1849300/]Steam[/url]]

This VN is an unofficial adaptation of and uses screenshots from the 1962 short film [url=https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0056119/]La jetée[/url].
translation:
《堤》是一部讲述“一个被童年影像深深烙印的男人”的视觉小说。

“从童年起，一段记忆便始终萦绕在主人公心头：在巴黎奥利机场的观景平台上，一位女子的身影，以及一名男子被杀的景象。核战争摧毁了整个世界，故事以地下营地为背景，讲述命运多舛的恋人这一永恒主题。营地的统治者无情地施行科学实验，声称是为了延续地球上的生命，却迫使人类放弃一切美好的事物。他们利用主人公的记忆，让他在时间中往返穿梭，寻找能源，拯救人类。在前往过去的旅程中，他遇见了一位女子，两人之间生出一段悲剧性的爱情。经历一连串事件后，男子终于来到那段始终困扰着自己的影像所发生的时间与地点。他看见了女子的脸；对他而言，那张脸象征着没有战争的世界中的爱情与生命。然而，就在与她相会之前，他被一名从地下营地追来的守卫杀死——那正是他此前逃出的地方。”

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1849300/]Steam[/url]]

本作是1962年短片[url=https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0056119/]《堤》[/url]的非官方改编作品，并使用了该片的截图。
